results.title: Funded Research - Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative
results.content: Recently, Wharton AI and Analytics Initiative funded a project to study “Reducing Gender and Racial Disparities in the Use of Generative AI in the Workplace.” While this research intends to enhance both academic research and practice over the longer-term, there is an immediate need to ensure that the “digital divide” in AI adoption does not manifest (or widen) among students enrolled in the courses, MGMT 2240 and MGMT 6240, Leading Diversity in Organizations. This research project aims to investigate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) investments by non-tech firms (AI-adopters) on product market competition, innovation, and industry dynamics. With proprietary data from Upwork Inc., the researchers are able to access full information on a large sample of jobs and workers over time, thus obtaining findings that can inform the effects of generative AI on the labor market and careers.

results.content: Upon completion of the program, students can pursue postgraduate studies or take licensing exams in their respective countries to obtain a medical license. **English medium instruction:** Many medical universities in Kazakhstan offer MBBS programs in English medium, making it easier for foreign students to study. So, for those students who really want to become doctors and are not able to get a seat here in India, MBBS from abroad is quite a better option and there are many countries which provide the same education level with good infrastructure of college in low-tuition fees as compared to India. Among many other reasons, in certain foreign countries, the cost of MBBS is less than some of the prestigious private medical colleges in India**.**So that brings us to the next question: which is the best country to study MBBS for Indian students. KYRGYZSTAN, an asian country which provides world class MBBS degree in low budget remains the first choice among Indian students as it opens several new options after completion of degree from there.
